sender.tl: Isang seller sa Facebook Marketplace o ibang marketplace sa social media
sender.en: A seller on Facebook Marketplace or another social media marketplace

name.tl: Pekeng online seller: nagbayad ka sa e-wallet, tapos naglaho ang seller
name.en: Fake online seller: money sent by e-wallet, then the seller vanishes

how.tl: May seller sa Facebook Marketplace o ibang social media page na nag-aalok ng cellphone, pagkain ng aso o iba pang item, madalas mas mura kaysa karaniwan. Pinapabayad ka nang buo o down payment sa GCash o Maya bago ipadala. Pagkabayad mo, bina-block ka o nawawala ang account, o pekeng mumurahing item ang dumarating. Ang online selling scam ang pinakamadalas na cybercrime na naitatala ng PNP-ACG.
how.en: A seller on Facebook Marketplace or another social media page offers a phone, pet food or other item, often below market price. They ask for full payment or a down payment by GCash or Maya before shipping. After you pay, the account blocks you or vanishes, or a cheap fake arrives. Online selling scams are the most common cybercrime the PNP-ACG records.

text.tl: May seller na nag-aalok ng item sa magandang presyo sa social media.
text.en: A seller offers an item at a good price on social media.

text.tl: Gusto nila ng buong bayad o deposit sa e-wallet muna, walang COD.
text.en: They want full payment or a deposit by e-wallet first, no cash on delivery.

text.tl: Minamadali ka: marami raw ibang buyer.
text.en: They rush you: many buyers are waiting.

text.tl: Pagkabayad, bina-block ka ng seller o peke ang ipinapadala.
text.en: After paying, the seller blocks you or sends a fake item.

text.tl: Still available, sis! Last stock, brand new sealed. Full payment via GCash first before I ship, there are many bogus buyers. I will send the tracking as soon as you pay.
text.en: Available pa po, sis! Last stock na lang, brand new sealed. Full payment muna via GCash bago i-ship ha, madami kasing bogus buyer. Send ko agad tracking pag nakabayad ka.

tl: nagbayad ako sa gcash tapos blinock ako ng seller
naglaho ang seller sa marketplace pagkabayad ko
peke ang dumating na cellphone na binili ko online
bayad muna bago i-ship daw walang cod
en: marketplace seller blocked me after i sent gcash
seller disappeared after i sent the money
online seller sent a fake phone
seller wants full downpayment before shipping no cod
scammed by a facebook marketplace seller

tl: Bayad sa e-wallet bago mo makita ang item.
Presyong mas mababa nang malaki kaysa sa iba.
en: Payment by e-wallet before you see the item.

tl: Gumamit ng cash on delivery, makipagkita sa ligtas na pampublikong lugar, o bumili sa platform na humahawak ng bayad mo.
I-report ang account ng seller sa marketplace at ang GCash o Maya number sa e-wallet mo.
Itago ang chats at resibo at i-report sa PNP-ACG o CICC 1326.
en: Use cash on delivery, meet in a safe public place, or buy inside a platform that holds your payment.
Report the seller’s account to the marketplace and the GCash or Maya number to your e-wallet.
Keep the chats and receipts and report to the PNP-ACG or CICC 1326.
